# Network Security

**Status:** Experimental
**API version:** v1
**Data plane:** Emulated in-process
**Endpoint coverage:** 9/13 (69%)

Project-scoped address groups (CRUD + LROs). Organization collections, IAM, addItems/removeItems/cloneItems, and listReferences are unregistered. Cloud Armor evaluateAddressGroup() reads project-global groups; evaluateOrganizationAddressGroup() still always returns false.

- `POST` `v1/{+parent}/addressGroups` — `projects.locations.addressGroups.create`
